quality.review_scope: Complete supplied four-page main and four-page matched SI read and independently audited. Canonical/reader, molecular, apparatus and symbolic product-context audits passed. Three alcohol-specific precipitation routes, eleven supporting procedures and five observation records remain separate. As-prepared whole-powder identity is unresolved despite local CeO2 microscopy; calcination, DLS and XPS exposure histories retain their own scopes. Source conflicts are preserved. No atomic model, exact structure-recipe pair or new training task is admitted.
missing_fields: Records and context counts do not count independent physical batches.
Three alcohol substitutions, as-prepared/calcined powders, solution DLS and XPS exposure states remain distinct.
As-prepared local CeO2 crystallites do not establish pure whole-powder composition.
No qualified atomic model, exact recipe–structure pair, automatic same-aliquot join or training admission.
